citations.assessment: The passage calls him Yeimar bar Chashu and describes his agent meeting Rav Pappa and Rav Huna son of Rav Yehoshua while seizing a boat.

holds.reason: Ketubot gives Yeimar bar Chashu, Rav Pappa and Rav Huna son of Rav Yehoshua in the actual dispute. The separate placement in Rabbah’s time is supplied by the compiler and remains without its own source.
